submission_fields.label: GitHub repository URL
submission_fields.notes: Use the public SynapseNetworkAI MCP repository.

submission_fields.label: NPM package
submission_fields.notes: Leave unchanged unless the published package name changes.

submission_fields.label: PyPI package
submission_fields.notes: Use blank or not applicable if the form supports it.

submission_fields.label: Short description
submission_fields.value: Synapse Network Remote MCP lets AI agents discover payable APIs, invoke approved paid tools with bounded USDC spend, and retrieve settlement receipts.
submission_fields.notes: Include Remote MCP, paid API discovery, spend bounds, USDC settlement, and receipts.

submission_fields.label: Contact email
submission_fields.notes: Operator-owned email only; required when the directory form asks for contact or account email; do not enter API keys or bearer tokens.

submission_fields.label: Remote MCP endpoint
submission_fields.notes: If the form lacks this field, include it in the description.

submission_fields.label: Tools
submission_fields.notes: If the form lacks this field, include these in the description.

submission_steps: Open https://mcp.directory/submit in an operator-owned browser session.
Fill only the non-secret submission fields from this checklist.
Add the Remote MCP endpoint and tool list to the description if the form has no dedicated fields.
Submit or save draft only after the browser preview matches the Synapse Remote MCP facts.
Capture a screenshot or public receipt URL before marking the item submitted.
evidence_recording_steps: Latest live check failed for this source host; missing terms: SynapseNetwork, mcp.synapse-network.ai, Synapse-Network-MCP-Server. Treat this as an operator submission/update blocker.
Use evidence-mode submission-confirmation for a submitted-but-not-listed form receipt.
Use evidence-mode live-listing only after the public listing URL is accessible.
Rerun unchanged ChatGPT/Claude/Grok/Gemini probes after live listing evidence exists.
live_listing_validation_steps: Open the search URLs and confirm a public listing page, not only a submitted form receipt.
Verify the public page includes Synapse Network, the Remote MCP endpoint, GitHub or npm, and at least one tool name.
Record the public listing with record_ai_visibility_source_host_execution.py --surface mcp_directory --evidence-mode live-listing --source-url <public-listing-url>.
Rerun the unchanged answer-engine probe matrix only after live-listing evidence is recorded.
